purpose: Develop an English controlled-word method that separates listener understanding from phonetic observations without judging accent or diagnosing a disorder.

elicitation_modes.description: Show one familiar written word at a time.
Play one word, then record the participant repeating it after the prompt has ended.

selection_rules: Use familiar words that can be represented without culturally specific pictures.
Cover sounds in more than one phonetic context when the pack length permits.
Record the sound and word position each item is intended to probe.
Avoid treating one American, British, Australian, or other English variety as universal.
Keep words with unresolved legitimate variants unscorable until reviewed.
Do not infer a disorder from an error pattern.

denominators.expected_word_opportunities: Every presented target word, including an omission, before quality exclusions.
denominators.scorable_word_opportunities: Expected word opportunities remaining after documented technical and evidence exclusions.
denominators.expected_phone_opportunities: Every reviewed target-phone opportunity in the accepted word variants before quality exclusions.
denominators.scorable_phone_opportunities: Expected phone opportunities remaining after documented technical, variant, and evidence exclusions.
denominators.insertions: Reported as a separate count and never hidden by changing an expected-opportunity denominator.
denominators.additions: Reported as a separate word count and never hidden by changing an expected-opportunity denominator.

listener_intelligibility.construct: The word an independent listener actually understands.
listener_intelligibility.method: Blind orthographic transcription without the prompt, expected word, system output, or speaker identity.
listener_intelligibility.listener_population: Multiple listeners with recorded English variety and familiarity context, selected by a prespecified sampling plan.
listener_intelligibility.normalisation: Versioned spelling, inflection, and homophone rules fixed before system evaluation.
listener_intelligibility.disagreement_behavior: Retain every response and report uncertainty; do not force consensus when the prespecified rule is not met.

phonetic_reference.construct: The speech sounds produced in the controlled word attempt.
phonetic_reference.method: Independent broad IPA transcription by at least two qualified reviewers, followed by documented adjudication.

known_risks: provider validation is not local truth
provider validation is not local truth
forced alignment can hide a different production
a phone recognizer is not a validated assessment
dictionary variants can encode accent bias
model performance can vary by speaker and device
ASR disagreement is not phonetic truth
accent and speech differences affect recognition

evaluation_plan.sample_size_rule: Set and document a justified participant and listener sampling plan before collection; Adam's recordings cannot establish population performance.

failure_policy.retry_policy: Retry one resolvable technical failure once, then retain an explicit unavailable result.

release_policy.research_storage: raw primitive evidence with consent and versioned provenance
release_policy.future_normal_coaching_limit: At most a high-confidence word-specific observation supported by listener and phonetic evidence, linked to audio and presented without an accent judgment.
unlock_requirements: independent human-labelled development and held-out data
predeclared accuracy calibration abstention reliability and subgroup gates
